name: injected-script
description: test.md 'A JASS map with injected functions (W3Champions-style)': injected-script.w3x (make-injected-script.mjs: flat.w3x whose war3map.j has an added global, two functions and an ExecuteFunc call in main). The editor opens and saves it: it regenerates the script from the triggers and the injected code is gone (the lines 'WE only' are the editor's regenerated lines). Studio, after a unit is placed and the project saved, keeps the file as it is (its guard asks 'Replace the script / Show Difference / Keep it'), so the injected code stays: the two differ, expected.
